Interface CustomerView

All Superinterfaces:
BaseView
All Known Implementing Classes:
SwingStoreView
public interface CustomerView extends BaseView
View interface for customer management operations and display. Extends BaseView to provide customer-specific user interactions including customer menu display and customer information visualization.

      void displayCustomerMenu()
      Displays the customer management menu to the user. Typically includes options for viewing, adding, updating, removing customers, and managing membership cards.

      void displayCustomers(List<CustomerDTO> customers)

      Parameters:

    • displayCustomer

      void displayCustomer(CustomerDTO customer)
      Displays detailed information for a single customer. Shows comprehensive customer details including personal information, membership status, and loyalty points.
      Parameters:
      customer - the CustomerDTO containing detailed customer information to display
